The '''Sivoria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] situated in the [[Interior Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system also contained [[Sivoria]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the system received its name from.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sivoria system's first and only appearance was in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' on page 136.<ref name="TEA" />
